kept.title: What the bad guys are chasing
kept.gist: Give the chase a reason: everyone is after what's on the device. The final reveal is the screen, full of connected ideas.
kept.visual_query: dusk rooftops, wet asphalt, neon glow
kept.why: from Tue 0:05: “running through a street defending off bad guys”

board.hook: Everyone wants what's in her hands

kept.title: Product to video, step by step
kept.gist: A simple map of the flow the launch video has to make feel seamless, from the device in hand to the finished video.
kept.visual_query: clean desk, soft daylight, pencil sketches
kept.why: from Mon 0:40: “the product, then the AI, and then the output”

kept.title: Creators finish each other's ideas
kept.gist: One creator speaks half a thought into the device and the next picks it up, so the connected ideas become the story itself.
kept.visual_query: warm room light, overlapping hands, close mics
kept.why: from Mon 0:01: “the hook being that the ideas are connected into”

kept.title: The chase in four beats
kept.gist: A stripped-down cut of the chase built for short attention: only the run, the leap, the device and the logo.
kept.visual_query: motion blur, gritty street, hard shadows
kept.why: from Mon 0:40: “The video should be pretty short.”

kept.title: The chase began as a voice note
kept.gist: A making-of piece: the fight-scene idea spoken into the device, turned into a card, then a board, then the finished chase playing out.
kept.visual_query: quiet room, screen glow, late night
